components.name: Marketing Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action in a public decision area.
components.css: .ds-marketing-primary { background: #F59E0B; color: #050A0F; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; padding: 16px 28px; font: 900 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 200ms; } .ds-marketing-primary:hover { background: #FFC04A; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-marketing-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #E8EBEE; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-marketing-primary { transition: none; } .ds-marketing-primary:hover { transform: none; } }

components.name: Marketing Secondary Link
components.description: A clear secondary route on a public page.
components.css: .ds-marketing-secondary { display: inline-flex; color: #E8EBEE; border: 1px solid #39434D; border-radius: 2px; padding: 15px 27px; font: 700 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-marketing-secondary:hover { background: #14191F; } .ds-marketing-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F59E0B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Portal Primary Button
components.description: A compact task action inside the portal.
components.css: .ds-portal-primary { background: #F59E0B; color: #0C0C0E; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 600 14px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-portal-primary:hover { background: #FFC04A; } .ds-portal-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #E8E8EC; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-portal-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Portal Input
components.description: A persistent-label field for portal settings.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #E8E8EC; font: 600 12px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { background: #151517; color: #E8E8EC; border: 1px solid #3A3A3E; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 400 14px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A0A0A6; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(245,158,11,.45); border-color: #F59E0B; }

narrative.overview: Muditek uses a dark, high-contrast visual system that feels like a serious operating environment. Public pages carry visual expression. Authenticated screens stay dense and quiet enough for repeated work.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navy public canvas with a single amber action color.
Near-black portal surfaces with dense, familiar controls.
Strong type hierarchy and readable body text.

rules.name: The Amber Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber identifies an action or state. It never becomes background decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Public pages use Inter and broad spacing. Portal screens use Geist and tighter fixed scales.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Static content surfaces use a tone or a border. A shadow signals elevation or an interaction state.

dos: Do preserve the dark navy, amber, high-contrast identity across public routes.
Do keep public pages expressive and portal pages dense and task-focused.
Do test every changed layout at 390px, 768px, and 1440px.
donts: Don't use equal-offer layouts that make three unrelated services appear equally important.
Don't use generic SaaS card grids, gated excerpts, or newsletter popups as a funnel substitute.
Don't overdecorate portal screens or ship empty beta cards.
